run_npz2ids_extract_object_ids: run the npz2ids tool to extract object instance segmentation IDs from a 3D scene graph NPZ file
run_npz2ids_cli: run the npz2ids CLI tool with an input NPZ path and output IDS path to write raw object IDs
run_main_extract_segmentation: run the main function to load an NPZ file and write building object instance segmentation bytes to disk
review_main_npz_parsing: review the main function that parses NPZ files using numpy and extracts object_inst_segmentation data
summarize_npz2ids_tool: summarize the npz2ids tool that converts 3D scene graph NPZ data into raw int16 object ID binary files
